integration_changes: RecBole data/loss/evaluator replaced with common RHPR next-item API and sampled-softmax.
Official MambaLayer and FeedForward math copied exactly, dependency imported lazily.
Only recommendation embedding and FFN Linear layers use normal(std=0.02); all native SSM parameters retain constructor initialization.
PAD embedding zeroed; histories use contiguous right padding; padded outputs masked after each causal layer.
Expose all causal states for last-128-position loss instead of only the last gathered state.
No positional embedding or timestamp features, matching original Mamba4Rec input policy.
Production requires native CUDA selective_scan fwd/bwd; test-only exact official CPU reference never used for GPU timing.
